A soft high-mid frozen buffer and broken resampling layer continuous granular glitch sustain with tiny buffer slips without a beat grid and continuous harmonic or noise movement. Add short freeze delay, spectral blur, and wide unstable reflections with large distant-room depth. The sound should feel like electric dust and evolve continuously as a sustained environment, not a beat, song section, or lead melody. Avoid drums, percussion, vocals, arpeggios, sequencer patterns, rhythmic pulses, EDM drops, sudden cuts, fade-outs, and silence.
